name: How do capital gains taxes affect the sale of an investment property?

mainEntity.name: How do capital gains taxes affect the sale of an investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Capital gains taxes apply to the profit made from selling an investment property. The tax rate depends on how long you've owned the property (short-term vs. long-term) and your income bracket. Understanding potential tax implications is crucial for maximizing your net proceeds. It's advisable to consult a tax professional to understand your specific liabilities and explore strategies like 1031 exchanges, which can defer capital gains when reinvesting in another property. A local real estate advisor can connect you with qualified tax experts in the South Florida area to help you plan effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Capital gains taxes apply to investment property profits, with rates varying by holding period and income. Consult a tax professional for specific guidance.
